label: MySQL
description: Run queries and manage rows in a MySQL database.
notes: No nodes transpiled. Every action (select_rows/find-rows, insert_row, update_rows, delete_rows, get_tables, execute_query) opens a raw TCP connection via the promise-mysql driver in mysqlConnect() (src/lib/common/index.ts) — a DB SDK client, not an HTTP request — and additionally builds parameterized SQL with sqlstring escaping and typed args arrays. MySQL exposes no vendor HTTP API, so none of this is expressible in the http runtime. All 6 actions classified needsPieceRuntime; a native runtime already covers this space in Agently (TOOL_DB_URL-gated DB tooling). Auth is CustomAuth with host/port/user/password/database fields, which would map to MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_PORT, MYSQL_USER, MYSQL_PASSWORD, MYSQL_DATABASE if a piece runtime adopts it.
